page_subtitle_html: This page mirrors the RWA.xyz Stablecoins view, including headline 30-day (30D) % changes plus Networks and Platforms tables (aggregate stablecoin market cap by chain and by issuer). Level columns are market-cap amounts.
kpi_window_note: All % changes in this row are 30-day (30D) (RWA.xyz). Headline totals from the RWA.xyz Stablecoins Overview.
key_observations_html:
• Stablecoin printed metrics were roughly flat this week: Market Cap near $299.30B (+0.5% 30D) means crypto dollar liquidity did not re-price hard—incremental demand is coming from product and banking-rail headlines rather than a market-cap surge. Related: White House crypto adviser Patrick Witt says he is 'optimistic and bullish' on Clarity Act as stablecoin fight resurfaces (The Block).
  • Stablecoin market structure remains concentration-led: leadership is still defined by a small set of large issuers/platforms; share shifts matter as much as aggregate market-cap growth. Related: OCC races to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules by November (The Block).
  • Bank rails are pushing stablecoins into treasury workflows: That pushes demand toward treasury and settlement use cases, not only exchange trading liquidity. Related: Metaplanet takes 96% of Super League in 2,100 BTC, cash deal to launch US bitcoin treasury firm (The Block).

Context only—not investment advice. Bullets combine on-page data with recent industry headlines.

Key observations are AI generated and should be reviewed for accuracy.
